title: Answer to Question: The Conflict in Lebanon Enters a New Stage
text:
Answer to Question

The Conflict in Lebanon Enters a New Stage

Question:

Is it true, as has been announced, that the conflict in Lebanon has entered a new stage? And if that is true, what has changed in the conditions of the Lebanese (game) for a new stage to begin?

Answer:

The statement that Lebanon has entered a new stage has a strong aspect of truth. For the picture to become completely clear, we will review the matter from its beginning:

1- America was the holder of influence in Lebanon from the Taif Agreement until the assassination of Hariri. Syria preserved America's influence in Lebanon from the time the Syrian army entered Lebanon with American permission.

2- After the assassination of Hariri, France (Chirac) found in it a golden opportunity from which it hoped to restore its influence to Lebanon. So Chirac escalated events and moved his followers in Lebanon, and succeeded in stirring up public opinion against America, Syria and its followers, until America agreed to the withdrawal of the Syrian army from Lebanon, and Syria then carried that out.

The political struggle continued hot between America, Syria and its followers on one side, and France and its followers on the other. Britain and its followers in Lebanon supported France from behind a curtain, without open confrontation with America, in accordance with Britain's policy, which does not show enmity to America openly but rather from behind a curtain.

3- The situation continued like this until Sarkozy came to power in France. He is known for his friendship with the American administration, as became clear during his election campaign. Therefore the hot conflict that had existed between America and France (Chirac) disappeared, and in its place came competition in a sporting spirit between America and its followers and France and its followers. Sarkozy hoped that an (understanding) would be reached with America on a solution in Lebanon that would take France's interests into account, and Sarkozy's France became active, going back and forth to Lebanon and striving earnestly for the solution.

4- Reaching this solution was expected. What was obstructing it was the dissatisfaction of Britain and its followers in Lebanon, for it would not accept that America and France alone should share the solution while it was left on the margin of events. And because it is distinguished by political cunning, its men in Lebanon, whenever any solution came close, would stir up a storm. However, this did not affect the two parties, neither France and the government, nor America, Syria and the opposition. Therefore the competition in a sporting spirit remained: this one flares up and that one flares up, then this one calms down and that one calms down, without escalating to hot political conflict, let alone reaching hot material conflict.

5- This situation continued: America and France and their followers in sporting competition in Lebanon, and (trouble-making) by Britain and its men, but without straining the relationship between France and America, and without Britain succeeding in changing the sporting (game) between the two teams. This continued until 27/3/2008 CE, at the meeting of French President Nicolas Sarkozy with British Prime Minister Gordon Brown in the wake of the crisis of the American mortgage companies, and the loss it caused of huge debts owed to European banks and companies as a result of the collapse of the American mortgage companies.

It appears that Britain, by its political cunning and Sarkozy's political naivety, succeeded in (embittering) Sarkozy's heart towards America over the huge loss that befell the European banks and companies as a result of the crisis of the American mortgage companies. This was reflected in the relationship in Lebanon, especially since France noticed that America was procrastinating over the solutions in order to prepare the conditions for America to regain its complete influence in Lebanon, without allowing France any piece, however small, of the Lebanese (cake).

Since that date it has been noticed that the French-American relationship in Lebanon has come to go beyond sporting competition, and Britain's actions have become no longer mere (trouble-making) that France's men in the government pay no heed to. Whereas the government used to take Jumblatt's trouble-making... for what it was worth, without it affecting the government's policy and decisions, the picture has been reversed and it has come to take it seriously.

6- During the month of April 2008 CE, the issue of the communications network and the airport cameras took a preparatory course towards choosing the time for heating up to boiling point... until there came Jumblatt's press conference and his raising of the communications network, the airport cameras and the airport security director...

7- Instead of the government dealing with Jumblatt's (agitation) as it had dealt with it before, that is, as mere (trouble-making) that does not affect decisions, this time it responded, because of the rapprochement between Britain and France. The government met and took the decision on the network and the cameras and the decision on the airport security director.

8- In summary, Britain, after detonating the issue of the communications network and the airport security director, drew France into supporting it in that, on the assumption that the reactions of America, Syria and the opposition would not be hot material reactions, especially as America is busy at the height of the election campaigns... and that the problem would then lead to placing the army in front of the opposition... and then the solution would be a settlement in which France, Britain and the loyalists would have a notable share.

9- France and Britain miscalculated, for America, Syria and the opposition hold strong lines, in numbers and in equipment, and the wise politician realises that the reactions will stop neither at sporting competition nor at hot conflict, but will go beyond it to hot material conflict. It is not unlikely that Britain was aware of that, but the weightier view is that it detonated the matter in order to shuffle the cards between France and America and their followers!

10- What is expected now is that these events will end in a settlement, but it will most likely be in favour of America, Syria and the opposition in Lebanon, and this scale will be the weightier one, while the scale of Europe and the loyalists in Lebanon will be the outweighed, sinking scale. It is not far-fetched that the solutions will give birth to a new Taif, whether by changing it in name and substance... in form and content, or by changing it in its content even if its name remains connected to the first name, such as being called (Taif 2)!

11- Therefore the statement about the new stage has an aspect of truth.

5 Jumada al-Ula 1429 AH
9/5/2008 CE
